title: Eremenko–Gabrielov secant conjecture
exact_target: Are all subspaces satisfying the stated disjoint-interval secant incidences real? The cited theorem proves this particular form.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1800002 (AMR-017-0002). CC BY 4.0.
S. N. Karp and K. Purbhoo, \emph{Universal Plücker coordinates for the Wronski map and positivity in real Schubert calculus}, arXiv:2309.04645v2 (2026), §1.3.2, Theorem 1.8; compare §5.7.2.
